svg.title: Original street and two Matrix extensions in world X/Z metres
svg.desc: Grey points sample the accepted reachable street. Green outlines show narrow causeways leading to 44 metre plazas beyond existing buildings. The two real exits bend northwest and southeast. This is geometry evidence, not a rendered view.

g.text: Phase 3.5 · one continuous world · X/Z metres
Accepted street · original spawn and terminals retained
Grey: 2 m street survey samples · yellow: fixed Q01–Q05 · green: finite new ground and safe perimeter
Causeways follow building gaps; city assets stay intact. Looking back at each transition remains open. Diagram is not visual acceptance.
